name: Ambassador Infernus' Bracer
summary: Ambassador Infernus' Bracer is proof of the ambassador's defeat in the Badlands. Historian Karnik asks you to bring it to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.

sections.title: Proof from Angor
sections.body: Historian Karnik sends you to Angor Fortress in the Badlands to destroy Ambassador Infernus. Ragnaros sent the ambassador to oversee Shadowforge's search for lost artifacts in Uldaman. The excavation has already cost many lives, and Karnik fears those artifacts could threaten Ironforge. Bring the bracer back to Advisor Belgrum as proof, so Belgrum can send aid to the site.

faq.answer: Ambassador Infernus' Bracer is proof of the ambassador's defeat, carried back to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.

faq.q: Where do I find the bracer?
faq.answer: The bracer comes from Ambassador Infernus at Angor Fortress in the Badlands.
Historian Karnik asks you to bring the bracer to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge as proof of Ambassador Infernus' defeat.

faq.q: Why is Ambassador Infernus in the Badlands?
faq.answer: Ragnaros sent Ambassador Infernus to oversee Shadowforge's search for lost artifacts in Uldaman.

faq.q: Why does Ironforge want the ambassador defeated?
faq.answer: The Shadowforge excavation has caused many casualties, and Historian Karnik fears the recovered artifacts could be used against Ironforge.

faq.q: What happens after I bring it to Belgrum?
faq.answer: Belgrum thanks you and says he will send word to Historian Karnik and arrange aid for the Badlands excavation site.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you carry proof of a threat to Ironforge: Shadowforge's search in Uldaman has already cost dwarven lives.
